resources.string: All four inference engine settings are optional. Choose Supply to enter a value; clear Supply to remove that field. Empty supplied text needs correction. No value is filled from the catalog.
tensor_parallel_size: a whole number, at least 1. This setting does not establish available hardware or engine compatibility.
max_batch_tokens: a whole number of tokens, at least 1. This setting does not establish throughput or a capacity limit.
%1$s: choose a literal value or leave it not supplied.

Recovery retains at most 20,000 characters across these controls (some symbols count as two). Longer input is replaced by a fixed unavailable notice. Live text stays available for correction until the form closes.
Enter a supplied value, or clear Supply to leave this field absent.
Enter a whole JSON number using ASCII digits, without grouping or rounding.
Choose one of the listed literal values or Not supplied.
This value exceeds the existing local JSON input limit. Shorten it before saving.
